messages:
alex: quick check — sketching a hysteresis-aware offload policy so we stop oscillating between GPU and host staging. putting a config sketch below, want feedback on semantics and rollout cautions.

mira: nice. my first q: cooldown per-allocation or global? per-alloc avoids knocking the same blob repeatedly.

sam: per-alloc + global dampening seems safer. per-alloc alone can starve big allocations (they never get a window).

igor: +1 on dampening. also we need tenant fairness: hysteresis could let one tenant hoard the GPU until low_watermark, hurting others. suggest we couple with admission tokens.

alex: good point. runtime invariants i'm aiming for:
- never evict if aggregate residency <= low_watermark_pct
- only trigger aggressive offload when >= high_watermark_pct
- cooldown prevents re-eviction for N seconds per-alloc
- admission tokens limit how many evictions a tenant can trigger in a window

example config:```
offload_policy:
  mode: hysteresis
  high_watermark_pct: 82
  low_watermark_pct: 68
  cooldown_seconds: 15
  token_bucket_ms: 1000
  tenant_penalty: 1.2  # multiplier to make noisy tenants pay
```

tanvi: can we extend the Lease API instead of adding separate plumbing? e.g. `Lease.set_policy({hysteresis: true, cooldown: 15})` so private deployments can tune without recompile.

sam: also think about observable signals: evict_count, re-read_rate, reclaim_latency, tenant_starvation_events. we should gate rollout on those.

mira: testing plan idea: replay recent hot traces in staging, toggle hysteresis, and measure oscillation (variance of residency over 1m windows). also unit tests for state transitions.

igor: what about mixed strategies? hysteresis + proactive prefetching for anticipated reads — keep hysteresis but allow prefetch hints to bypass cooldown for critical pages. adds complexity but smooths latency.

alex: agreed — prefer to land a minimal API first (watermarks + cooldown + token bucket) then iterate on prefetch exemptions. rollout plan: default off; enable in canary with metric guards; roll to Dedicated-tier first.

sam: one more: make sure eviction reasons are tagged (hysteresis_eviction vs pressure_eviction) so we can drill into cause.

deploy-bot: canary flag created: `offload.hysteresis: disabled` — canary toggle ready for eu-cluster. :rocket:

alex: thanks everyone. i'll draft a short RFC follow-up with the config shapes, invariants, and a metrics checklist. will link PR when ready.
